description_en: Modifies the hot standby replica mode of a database node in a specified cluster
description_zh: 修改指定集群中数据库节点的热备副本模式
name: ModifyDBNodeHotReplicaMode

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database cluster node
parameters.name: db_node_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable hot standby. Valid values:
ON: Enabled.
OFF: Disabled.
Limits: This operation is supported only for non-serverless MySQL clusters. The target node must be a read-only node. Each cluster allows only one node to have HotReplicaMode (ON). Usage notes: Append the following limits to the end of the HotReplicaMode parameter description: this operation is supported only for non-serverless MySQL clusters. The target node must be a read-only node. Each cluster allows only one node to have HotReplicaMode (ON)
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启热备。取值范围：

ON：开启

OFF：关闭

使用限制：仅非 Serverless 的 MySQL 集群支持此操作；目标节点必须为 Reader（只读）节点；每个集群最多允许一个节点开启 HotReplicaMode（ON）。调用说明：在 HotReplicaMode 参数描述末尾追加使用限制说明：仅非 Serverless 的 MySQL 集群支持此操作；目标节点须为 Reader（只读）节点；每个集群仅允许一个节点开启 HotReplicaMode（ON）
parameters.name: hot_replica_mode
